body:
What about the case when the user supplies a string that is not in the cases provided here?

[In RFC6265bis](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-20#name-the-samesite-attribute-2) we have the attribute be set to `Default` when the string is not `lax`, `none`, or `strict`.
